mapper.select: select e.employee_id from att_employee e join sys_user u on u.user_id=e.user_id and u.del_flag='0' join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id and d.del_flag='0' where e.site_id=#{siteId} and e.hire_date <= #{date} and (e.leave_date is null or e.leave_date >= #{date}) and not exists (select 1 from att_daily_result r where r.employee_id=e.employee_id and r.attendance_date=#{date}) order by e.employee_id limit 1001

select e.*,u.user_name,u.dept_id,d.dept_name from att_employee e join sys_user u on u.user_id=e.user_id and u.del_flag='0' join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id and d.del_flag='0' where e.employee_id=#{employeeId} and e.site_id=#{siteId} and e.hire_date <= #{date} and (e.leave_date is null or e.leave_date >= #{date})

select result_id from att_daily_result where site_id=#{siteId} and result_status='PENDING' and ((work_day=1 and date_add(start_window_end,interval 1 minute)<=#{now} and date_add(end_window_end,interval 1 minute)<=#{now}) or (work_day=0 and date_add(attendance_date,interval 1 day)<=#{now})) order by result_id limit 1000
